title: One source for every fact, and the globe draws change as patches
set_out: Make every document come from one source, finish the catalogue line by line, and keep the GitHub machines full.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Each cell's change layer on the globe, with clustered losses (GRP-015, DEV-EACH-CELL-01 exploration 5)
entries.what: Clustered losses planted by the one command in four blood cells, read on each cell's own layer.
entries.outcome: A clustered loss lights its own cell's layer once loss times share is a few percent of the DNA; other cells' layers barely move.

entries.title: Sites held by one cell alone (GRP-015, DEV-EACH-CELL-01 exploration 7)
entries.what: A loss across a cell's whole pattern, read on identity sites and on sites specific to each cell.
entries.outcome: Specific sites do not place a whole-pattern loss on one cell; a joint reading of all cells is the next idea (plan 39.17).

entries.title: Met-A against the atlas: the second sealed test's synthetic run through the one command (GRP-014)
entries.what: 36 constructed monocyte arrays laid out like the declared list, each slide with its own offset, read and tared by the one command and scored by the sealed scorer.

entries.title: Every tool fires: blood drawn years before a diagnosis (CAN-007, DEV-FIRES-01)
entries.what: EPIC-Italy's 845 whole bloods (spent), smoke run of four arrays through the whole chain with all 79 atlas cells.

entries.title: The C-Score family's plan (GRP-015, plan 41)
entries.what: 41.1 IAM-A's C-Score version 2: each 1,000-CpG region's held error predicted from that region's OWN loose share by the self-reference line. Version 1 (one genome-wide rate) gave a healthy C of about 6 because healthy regions differ by nature; if IAM's law holds region by region, a healthy C falls toward 1, so it is a physics test too. 41.2 the whole-genome C-Score against the atlas. 41.3 each cell's C-Score in a mix.

entries.title: CHAIN CHANGE: the C-Score for every cell found and for the whole genome (GRP-015, plan 41.2, 41.3)
entries.what: stage_metaa_atlas.cscore_in_mix, flagged: the commissioned C-Score's statistic (blocks of 10 neighboring sites in genome order) on each cell's departure map against the atlas mixed at the sample's own shares, and on every atlas site measured. Every cell the Deconvolver finds is scored; below 1 % of the sample the C is flagged, not withheld. On a check of the statistic: 0.96 for independent values, 2.34 with clustered runs. Synthetic test 1 plants in every cell found on a healthy blood and three known tissue mixtures.

entries.title: Met-A against the atlas: the second sealed test written; its synthetic test run 1 refused by the chain (GRP-014, METAA-ATLAS-SEAL-02)
entries.what: 36 healthy monocyte arrays of two laboratories (GSE157611, GSE196007) chosen from metadata only; same-slide tare; the same three bars. The synthetic test through the one command: run 1 (explore run 39932749386) built arrays with only the 6,000 identity sites, and Stage T step 1 refused all 36 because both probe designs are needed, a fault of the construction; rebuilt at every atlas site and rerun. The seal waits on it.

entries.title: What public data exists for early detection (CAN-007, plan 42)
entries.what: Metadata only. Rare sets kept unread for sealed tests: the same 20 people at baseline and year 6 (GSE130748), blood before a liver cancer diagnosis (GSE113392), a 15-year stroke cohort with later cancers (GSE280206), matched plasma and blood DNA (GSE325660). Plasma cfDNA on EPIC with IDATs at diagnosis: GSE277078, GSE298812, GSE157273, GSE220160. No public plasma drawn before a diagnosis was found. Stool: GSE212997 (newborn stool, including stool taken before illness, held unread).

entries.title: Records checked against the logs (OTH-072)
entries.what: Every result of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 was checked against the development log, the day logs, the manifest and the plan; the development log had 2 entries for 2026-10-22 where 16 results stood in their records, and these entries were added from the records' own numbers.

entries.title: Each cell's healthy spread in whole blood, written before it runs (GRP-015, DEV-EACH-CELL-01 exploration 8)
entries.what: Every fifth of Group-A's 278 healthy bloods (56) through the one command on the full atlas panel, with the every-site reading: how much each cell's Met-A varies between healthy people, and so how large a loss must be before it shows for each cell. Running on GitHub.

entries.title: Priority (CAN-007)
entries.what: Author: human early cancer detection first, through the full chain on whole blood, buffy coat, plasma cell-free DNA and tissue, every tool that can fire scoring whatever is found; the remaining C-Scores and Met-A against the atlas commissioned. Salmon parked until then.

entries.title: The information sphere passes on the real atlas: test 11 (ATL-046)
entries.what: Construction v5, IAM-Atlas v2.1's 79 healthy cell types, each line from 1,000 level-matched groups (explore run 39913125753): C1 11 of 12 marker groups together beyond their level, C2 0 of 100 twins, C3 rho 0.8065. PASSED. The sphere places together sites that behave alike across cells, beyond their level, and invents nothing. Next: one person against their own healthy cells.

entries.title: Depth: a planted loss at 60 reads, and constructed draws at 30 (GRP-016, DEV-ONE-DRAW-01)
entries.what: At 60 reads per site a 5 % CD4 T loss moves 11.0 of its error (4.6, 6.2, 8.7 at 3, 10, 30). At 30 reads, hepatocyte DNA from 0.01 is found near its size (0.0067 at 0.01, 0.0192 at 0.02); colon from 0.02; below about 0.02 shares move with the draw at every depth.

entries.title: The firm rate's one-sample human timing test (PHY-006)
entries.what: GSM2387332 on one GitHub machine: index 6,814 s, 10 million pairs aligned in 6,827 s, molecules in 306 s; the count stopped because the workflow lacked the chain's requirements (fixed).

entries.title: The flat picture and the globe count change the same way, and the globe draws changed blocks as patches (ATL-063)
entries.what: Blocks of 10 neighboring sites beyond the 5 % family-wise line on both; each changed block painted over its stretch of genome.

entries.title: The instrument catalogue corrected line by line at its sources; a status-claim check and a no-dates check in the push gate
entries.what: Every fix made in CANON/catalogue.json and CANON/instruments.json, which rebuild the page, the README table, the website and the book's toolbox chapter.

entries.title: One build command for every generated document (CANON/build_all.py)
entries.what: 28 generators in data-flow order, then the cross-document checks; the push gate runs it first.

entries.title: The information sphere as a picture (ATL-046)
entries.what: Drawn by the one command from IAM-Atlas v2.1: each site colored by the cell family whose identity it carries; the blood lineages lie side by side, the tissues in their own regions; on the Globe Explorer.

entries.title: One sample on the information sphere (ATL-046)
entries.what: The one command reads a sample's change on the information sphere; the example healthy blood lights no territory.

entries.title: The 6,000-site globe layers on the full healthy map (ATL-063)
entries.what: Met-A's layer and each cell's layer fade the full healthy map instead of gray; counts unchanged.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes, and what caught each

entries.title: The C-Score's synthetic test chose its cells by assumption
entries.what: The first version planted losses in four blood cells picked in advance. The author caught it: which cells are there is the IAM-Deconvolver's answer. It was canceled before it ran; the test now plants in every cell the Deconvolver finds, and every cell found gets a C-Score (flagged below 1 %).

entries.title: A synthetic array built with too few sites
entries.what: The second Met-A seal's synthetic arrays held only the 6,000 identity sites; the chain's own self-tare refused all 36 because a real array has both probe designs. Rebuilt at every atlas site.

entries.title: The sealed Met-A test stood unstarted
entries.what: The explorations it needed had finished unread; the author asked where the test was. Both were read and the second sealed test written the same hour.

entries.title: Notes written on the wrong manifest row, and logs behind their records
entries.what: The firm-rate recount notes sat on PHY-049 instead of PHY-006 (moved). The development log carried 2 of 16 results for 2026-10-22; the author asked for a check of every report, and the entries were added from each record's numbers.

entries.title: Four finished runs left unread overnight (OTH-072)
entries.what: The run watcher followed a hand-typed list of runs; four started before it (sphere test 11, the timing test, two depth runs) finished unread for several hours. The watcher now reads every run from GitHub against a ledger of runs already read, and reports idle machines.

open_at_turnover: Open: Group-A's reproduction through the one command (GRP-004); the plasma arrays (GRP-016); the firm-rate human timing sample (PHY-006); information sphere test 11 (ATL-046); each cell's healthy spread (GRP-015, exploration 8).
